notice: Fictional negative fixture derived from the valid sample pack; not accepted evidence and not an operating case.
intent: Each fixed location is flat across the whole window with complete coverage, so moving fixed-duration activities cannot reduce the integral. Location levels still differ.

steps: Set every yard hour to 50 ug/m3 and every office hour to 20 ug/m3 in the nominal CSV.
Apply the pinned +20 transformation, giving 70 and 40 ug/m3 respectively.
Re-bind raw, selection and evidence hashes and bump each changed evidence revision.

checked_search_scope.note: Only these three illustrative schedules were checked. No claim is made about undiscovered schedules.

arithmetic.derivation: Each location is constant, so a fixed-duration activity contributes level * duration wherever it starts. Yard holds two one-hour activities and office one two-hour activity.

expected.notes: Zero gain is a correct result, not a failure. A flat source cannot be turned into a timing benefit by reordering labels.
